identity: Full Standard InChIKey from sanitized decoded stored SMILES; preserve encoded stereo/isotopes; no extra salt, stereo-free or tautomer rules
on_identity_failure: quarantine; never treat failure as a unique nonoverlapping molecule

group_b.ordering: explicit deterministic order; never unordered Python set iteration
group_b.new_holdout_candidates: Prefer existing global test/validation key ownership; fill approximately 0.5% targets using unowned keys, without splitting conformer groups. Keys excluded from a target due to quota may not fall back into training.

group_c.conformations_molecule_overlap_with_trai: allowed; do not use conformation-test identities as a molecular blacklist

global_test_precedence: Fixed Group A test + nabla structures/scaffolds + GEOM-revisited protected before selecting new Group B/C holdouts; apply protection to training and validation of every source
global_validation_precedence: Every selected validation identity excluded from every training dataset
fixed_test_sets: Keep separate; report identity overlap between test datasets rather than assigning test molecules to training
exact_conformation_exposure: report separately from molecule identity overlap; user-requested conformations exception must not be mistaken for a globally molecule-disjoint benchmark
source_snapshot_limitation: Surviving grouped inputs may already reflect historical exclusions; this is not a reconstruction of all pristine original source rows. ChEMBL uses later verified replacements with changed populations.
nabla_scaffold_policy_note: User explicitly chose full InChIKeys only; no Murcko/scaffold or stereo-free matching
